packages.title: Menos detalles keeps a first step typed without Enter
brief: Context: UX-622 (S2): in the task form, text typed in `Añadir paso` without Enter is lost when the user taps `Más detalles` / `Menos detalles` (key `task-more-details`). No copy changes in this package: no ARB edits, no gen-l10n.

Last attempt (P110, b8 round 2): added `final _steps = GlobalKey();` (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:41) and passed it to both ChecklistEditors, the collapsed one (about :586-593, built only `if (_checklist.isNotEmpty)`) and the expanded one (about :665-671). That fixed a task that already has a step: the editor moves between branches with its text. Keep the GlobalKey and its comment exactly as they are.

Why it was only partly fixed (reviewer B, inferred from code): on a task with no steps, the collapsed branch builds no ChecklistEditor, because `_checklist` is empty. The only `Añadir paso` field is inside `Más detalles`. If the user types a first step there and taps `Menos detalles`, the GlobalKey has nowhere to go: the editor is disposed, `dispose` removes the `_addFocus` listener (App/lib/widgets/checklist_editor.dart:44) before the focus change arrives, and `_addLeft` never commits the text.

Fix, in the `task-more-details` TextButton's `onPressed` (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart, about :550-553; today `() => setState(() => _detailsExpanded = !_detailsExpanded)`): make it async and do what `_save` already does at :258-266 before the form changes shape. 1) Read the target first: `final expand = !_detailsExpanded;`. 2) Only when collapsing (`!expand`): `FocusScope.of(context).unfocus(); await Future<void>.microtask(() {}); if (!mounted) return;`. Leaving the field commits the step through `_addLeft` → `_addStep(next: false)` → `onChanged`, which sets `_checklist` synchronously, so after the microtask `_checklist` is non-empty. 3) `setState(() => _detailsExpanded = expand);`. The collapsed branch then shows the ChecklistEditor (it is non-empty now) with the new step. Add a one-line comment pointing at `_save`'s reason.

When expanding (`Más detalles`), toggle at once as today, without unfocusing, so tapping it while typing the title doesn't close the keyboard. The GlobalKey already covers the collapsed editor moving into the expanded form.
Setting `_detailsExpanded = expand` (instead of negating it after the await) makes two quick taps on `Menos detalles` land on the collapsed form once, not flip back.

Don't touch: the GlobalKey `_steps`; the `if (_checklist.isNotEmpty)` condition on the collapsed editor (showing the steps section on an empty task is a layout change nobody asked for); the order of the fields P21 set; `_save` and `_back`; App/lib/widgets/checklist_editor.dart; App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart; App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart; any ARB file. Reviewer B also noted that removing the last step through ⋮ in the collapsed form hides the section along with any text in `Añadir paso`. That predates this run and isn't part of this package.
Tests: keep the existing UX-622 test in App/test/task_editor_form_test.dart (a task with one step, about :389) passing; ux-tester writes the new acceptance test.
acceptance: Widget test (task_editor_form_test.dart): in Spanish at 1× on 360×740, editing a task with no steps, tap `task-more-details`, type `Coat` in `add-checklist-item` without pressing Enter, and tap `task-more-details` (`Menos detalles`). The collapsed form shows exactly one step titled `Coat`, and the `add-checklist-item` field is empty.
Widget test: after that, tap `task-more-details` (`Más detalles`) again. There is still exactly one step `Coat`, with no duplicate, and no exception is thrown.

Widget test: on a task with no steps, with `Más detalles` open and `Coat` typed in `add-checklist-item`, two quick taps on `task-more-details` (one pump between them) leave exactly one step `Coat` and the form collapsed.
Widget test: the existing one-step UX-622 test (task with step `Pasaporte`, `Coat` typed, toggled twice) still passes.
Code: the `task-more-details` onPressed unfocuses and awaits a microtask, then checks `mounted`, before the setState that collapses the form; both ChecklistEditors still pass `key: _steps`.
deviceChecks: On an Android phone, open a task with no steps, tap `Más detalles`, type a step in `Añadir paso` without Enter, tap `Menos detalles`: the step shows in the short form, and it is still there after saving and reopening the task.
